videos.title: What Happens If You Slam the Brakes on a Wet Road? (3D) 🚗
videos.description:
Without ABS the wheels lock and the car slides straight into the cones, no matter how you turn the wheel. With ABS the wheels keep rolling and the car steers around.
Have you ever felt that pedal buzz? 👇
